text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I go to the training track and find...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Jooordaaaaan! Stop right there!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You can't paint your nails on the course!
What are
you thinking?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aw, just gimme a sec, Bamboo. I literally
only
have to let the top coat dry and
then I'm good!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Let it dry ? Look! Do you even need to be painting your nails here to begin with?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I mean, it's way more motivating to run with pretty nails!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh? Are you pulling my leg?
choice_data_list: ネイルは爪の保護にもなるな
ネイルは爪の保護にもなるね
choice_data_list_en: Nail polish protects your nails, too.
Nail polish protects your nails, too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wow. You know your stuff. So you've
got your
nails done too?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, are you like, a top-coat-only kinda
person?
Or do you use more than just
polish?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Uhh, what're you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Also, you know where this is going,
right,
Bamboo? You've totally gotta do
your nails too.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! What do you mean "where this is
going"?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Kinda like Othello, you know? You flip
and end
up a nail-doer yourself 'cause
you got
sandwiched.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No thanks! They'll come right off the
second I
swing my bamboo sword!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Then, like, what about decorating your
sword?
Same-same.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Decorate my sword?! Th-that never
occurred to
me!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ooh, you're totally in on this. Wooo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's nothing to "woo" about! No way
I'm
decorating it!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, welp, jokes aside, nails will legit
make your
race pop, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
How's about a design to match your
signature
racewear? I've got the colors
here, so I can do
your nails for you.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
A design that matches my signature
racewear...
Th-that does sound like it'd
get me fired up...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, my nails are dry.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: All righty, I'll teach you next time!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you're not gonna do them for me?!
C'mon,
what's your deal?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Y-you being serious here?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Decorate... my bamboo sword... Make
it... shiny?
Blind my opponents?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's playing dirty!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, that idea never even occurred
to me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Anyway, just quit worrying and do it! Honestly, decorating a bamboo sword's such a first! It'll totally be fire!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, hey! Where are you taking
me?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Thanks for saying that. You
really saved
me, boss!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aw, but I could've played around with so
many
designs! It would've been seriously
fun.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hey, listen. This bamboo sword is a
symbol of my
soul!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's a pure and righteous blade that cuts
through
corruption! How could you even
think of
decorating my precious—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my nails are dry now. Back to
training.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hey! I was talking to you! WAIT UP!
